# Càirdeas 2022 Warehouse 1 Whisky

Matured in our iconic warehouse a skipping-stone’s throw from the Islay coast. For flavours of peat, smoke and sea salt that soar with bitter maritime character. Friends only.

## MORE FLAVOUR FOR OUR FRIENDS​

Our Càirdeas expression for 2022 was created especially for Friends of Laphroaig® to give them more of what they love. This limited edition single malt whisky, aged in first-fill Maker’s Mark Bourbon barrels, dials up quintessential Laphroaig® taste. Classic flavours are elevated by a coastal character that can only come from sea spray and storms. It’s a match made in Islay.​ ​ Warehouse 1’s rare four-storey construction, fluctuating temperature, and exposure to rugged conditions tease out enigmatic flavours and a maritime quality. While traditional distilling, careful cask selection and patience deliver renowned flavours.​ ​ Laphroaig® Càirdeas 2022 is bottled at a fixed strength of 52.2% for a memorable experience to share with Friends.

![Close up of Laphroaig Cairdeas Warehouse 1 with glass of whisky on stone wall](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-05/laphroaig_Cairdeas_warehouse1_desktop_4.jpg.webp?itok=HX2eQ73K)

## TASTING NOTES

_![Color of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-05/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_color-01_0.svg.webp?itok=vAZoCalO)_

### Colour

A pale gold appearance reflects the careful aging process and fixed-strength bottling.​

_![Aroma of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-05/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_aroma-01.svg.webp?itok=u9Aui-4M)_

### Nose

Peaty, sweet and nutty with “medicinal” notes. Strong vanilla cake, fudge, heather-honey, golden syrup, walnuts and nutmeg.​

_![Tasting Notes of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-05/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_taste-01.svg.webp?itok=l76aPZcs)_

### Palate

Powerful peat-reek and ashy notes of tar combine with sweet Manuka honey and burnt toffee.

_![Finish of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-05/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_finish-01.svg.webp?itok=QmFxJ8uQ)_

### Finish

Peaty and acidic with lingering herbal and spicy notes leading to a floral aftertaste.

_![Maturation of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-05/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_maturation-01.svg.webp?itok=rw9WDfbW)_

### Maturation

Aged in first-filled Maker’s Mark Bourbon casks in Warehouse 1, with extra exposure to the elements.
